l4d2.notes: Fresh Linux installs fail with 'Invalid platform' unless installed as Windows first.

csgo.notes: No version_app_id: the CS:GO server (app 740) hasn't changed since CS2 replaced it (version 1575, Oct 2023), so the image is only built when missing. Its server ships the client's content; vpk_strip and prune drop what a dedicated server doesn't load (textures, audio, UI images, the China/low-violence variants, the Panorama UI: 28 GB -> 4.4 GB). Its bundled libgcc_s is older than the image's libstdc++, which the engine then fails to load.

bms.prune: bms/bms_textures_* bms/bms_sounds_misc_* bms/bms_sound_vo_english_* bms/bms_maps_* hl2/hl2_textures_* hl2/hl2_sounds_misc_*
bms.notes: Black Mesa. Its server ships the client's content (33 GB); a dedicated server doesn't load textures, audio, the singleplayer maps (the multiplayer ones are loose files) or models' render meshes (.vtx), so those are dropped (5.2 GB).
